objects.name: One wallet-phishing operator, six servers in three weeks: followed by the names it carried host to host
objects.description: Twenty-four names moved with one wallet-phishing operation across six servers between 27 October and 14 November 2026, the stretch NSS's own resolution record covers; six of them went the whole way from the first server NSS recorded to the sixth, the server behind NSS-TK-01, the fake imToken download sites. Twenty-two of the moved names sat behind the operation's forwarding layer, each keeping its own label while the address behind it changed. The operation's oldest names were bought in July and on lists from August. Of the 104 names NSS saw on the six servers, 34 were on a threat list NSS takes in on 14 November; the 43 names that first appeared on the current server were on none.
